verdict.rationale: CIPO is an IP office whose online services could plausibly offer background automations such as scheduled alerts or auto-renewals, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows manual filing, search, account login, bulk data downloads and electronic correspondence. Nothing documents user-configurable automations that run autonomously in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
